title: Anthropic Executive Says Open-Source AI Models Are Higher Risk
source_used: shattered.io (a secondary site summarising the Bloomberg TV interview)
key_facts: Guillaume Princen is Anthropic's head of international.
He spoke to Bloomberg TV at the International AI Summit in Dublin on 14 October 2026.
He said publicly released model weights carry a higher chance of misuse than models kept behind an API.
He said: 'I can't talk for open models. But by definition, there's more risk with them.'
He named no specific competing model or company in the clips circulated.
Anthropic's published policy says it does not want open-weight models banned (secondary site; not verified).
quote_evidence: "We need to be really careful with open-source on safety," Princen told Bloomberg TV.
"I can't talk for open models. But by definition, there's more risk with them."
why_it_matters_hint: A senior Anthropic executive restates the company's wariness of open-weight models.
